hero.title: Questions we get asked about GEO
hero.answer: HARGILE makes businesses visible in AI answers and on Google. Here are the direct answers to the questions people ask before getting started: how long, what results, how it works, and how much it costs.

items.a: GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. It is the work of making your business appear in the answers that AI assistants give — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews. When someone asks 'which accountant should I use in Brussels', the assistant cites sources. GEO is what makes your site one of those sources: machine-readable content, structured data, clear answers to the questions your buyers actually ask.

items.q: How do I know if AI already mentions me?
items.a: You ask. We run 25 questions that your buyers are likely to ask AI about your industry and your region, and we record which answers cite you, which cite your competitors, and which cite nobody. That is the free diagnostic: you get the results within 48 hours, with no commitment.

No. GEO builds on SEO. The foundations are the same: clean structure, fast site, structured data, content that answers real questions. What GEO adds is the lens of answer engines — making sure the content is not just indexable by Google, but citable by AI. We do both, because they reinforce each other.

items.q: What types of businesses benefit most from GEO?
items.a: Any business whose clients research before buying: professional services (law, accounting, consulting), health practitioners, B2B companies, local businesses with a speciality. If someone might ask an AI assistant 'who does X in Y', and you do X in Y, GEO matters to you.

items.q: How long until we see results?
items.a: Technical fixes — speed, structure, structured data — show effects within weeks. Content-driven improvements take longer: typically two to four months for Google rankings to move, and AI citation patterns shift on their own schedule as models update. We track both from day one so you see the trajectory, not just the destination.

items.q: Do you guarantee first position on Google?
items.a: No, and nobody honest can. Google's algorithm is not ours to control, and neither are the AI models. What we commit to is the method: clean technical foundations, content that answers real questions, structured data, and full transparency about what it produces. An agency that guarantees rankings has already told you something about the rest.

items.q: How do GEO and SEO work together?
items.a: SEO makes your site rank on Google. GEO makes your site get cited by AI assistants. The work overlaps heavily: structured data, fast loading, clear content written around real questions. We treat them as one workflow because the same optimizations feed both channels. A page that ranks well on Google is already halfway to being cited by AI — and the other half is what we add.

items.q: How does the free diagnostic work?
items.a: You give us your website URL. We run 25 questions your buyers are likely to ask AI, check which answers mention you or your competitors, and audit your site's technical SEO foundations. You get a written report within 48 hours. No commitment, no payment. If the results show room for improvement, we explain what we would do. If they don't, we tell you that too.

items.q: What's included in the monthly service?
items.a: Three things. First, AI citation monitoring: we track whether answer engines mention you, and for which questions. Second, content and technical optimization: structured data, on-page improvements, new content when needed. Third, reporting: Google rankings, organic traffic, AI citations, all in a shared dashboard. What is not included: paid advertising, social media management, and link-building schemes. We do the work that makes your site the answer, not the work that games the system.

With shared data. Google rankings, organic traffic, and AI citations are tracked in a dashboard you have access to — the same numbers we look at, at the same time. No cherry-picked metrics, no reports that only show the good numbers. If something is not working, you see it when we do.

hero.title: Your visibility, automated
hero.answer: We make SMEs visible where their customers actually search: on Google, and now in the answers of AI assistants like ChatGPT and Perplexity. Technical SEO, content and measurement, automated where possible, for a durable result rather than a one-off campaign.

audit.title: Audit
audit.text: First, the facts: what makes you visible today, what holds you back, and where the queries that matter to your business are.

tech.title: Technical
tech.text: A site engines can read without obstacles: speed, structure, structured data, content present from the first load.

content.title: Content
content.text: Pages that each answer one real customer question, the format Google and answer engines cite.

measure.title: Measure
measure.text: Rankings, traffic, AI citations: we track what changes, and we adjust. What is not measured does not improve.

metaProof.title: This page is the demonstration
metaProof.text: The method we propose is the one we apply to our own site:
points: Every page exists in French and English, with the tags that tell engines which one to serve.
Every page carries its structured data (schema.org), validated automatically before every release.
All the content is in the HTML from the first response, readable by search engines and AI assistants alike.
View this page's source: it is all there.

measured.title: This page, in numbers
measured.lead: Measured on {date} on this very page, with {tool}, under mobile conditions. You can run the tool yourself and land on the same figures, and that is the whole point of publishing them.
measured.note: The main content paint is still over its 2.5 second threshold, and we leave it on display rather than picking the numbers that suit us. That one is work in progress. An agency that only publishes its good scores is not telling you what it measures: it is telling you what it shows.

geo.title: Being cited by AI answers
geo.lead: When a client asks ChatGPT or Perplexity which agency builds web applications in Brussels, the assistant answers by citing its sources. Being one of those sources is where visibility now starts, and it is worked page by page.

readable.title: Content machines can read
readable.text: The answers are in the HTML on the first response, with no JavaScript to run. An answer engine that only sees an empty page will never cite anything.

structured.title: Structured data
structured.text: Every page states what it is and who wrote it, in schema.org format. That is what lets an engine attach an answer to one specific company.

answers.title: One page, one real question
answers.text: Pages are written to answer, plainly, a question your clients actually ask. That is the format answer engines quote and attribute.

schema.sourceNote: your page, cited as a source

measures.title: What we measure and what we don't promise
measures.text: You don't have to take our word for it. The numbers are tracked and shared: we look at the same ones you do, at the same time.
points: Positions on the queries that matter to your business, not the ones that look good in a report.
Organic traffic, with the honest timeline: a few weeks for what is technical, several months for what is editorial.
Pages cited by answer engines, tracked on the same footing as Google positions.
measures.refusal: What we will not sell: a guaranteed first position, or the certainty of being cited by AI. Nobody controls Google's algorithm, nobody controls the models, and an agency that promises you either has already told you something about the rest. What we commit to is the method, and transparency about what it produces.

proofCase.text: VENIZI sells its jewellery online and across a network of 50 boutiques in Belgium and France: a catalogue where every product has to be findable.

items.q: How long before we see results?
items.a: SEO is a long-term investment: technical fixes show effects within weeks, content within months. It is slower than advertising, but it does not stop when the budget does.

items.q: Do you guarantee the first position on Google?
items.a: No, and nobody serious can: results depend on an algorithm nobody controls. What we do guarantee is the method: clean technical foundations, content that answers real questions, measurement, and transparency about what it produces.

items.q: What does being visible in AI answers mean?
items.a: When someone asks ChatGPT or Perplexity which agency can build a web application in Brussels, those assistants cite their sources. Being cited is the new ranking, and it can be worked on: machine-readable content, structured data, and clear answers to the questions people actually ask.
You do not have to take our word for it: rankings, organic traffic and cited pages are tracked and shared. We look at the same numbers you do.

grid.hint: Newest first. Click a square to open the site.

ownership.title: Your code, your data

deliverables.title: What you receive

design.text: Screens and user journeys, drawn by the same team that then codes them. You get the mockups, not only the result on screen.

code.titleRest: in a repository under your name

live.text: Deployed on your own domain, in one language or several: a trilingual site is a routine request here, not an exotic add-on.

keys.text: Hosting, domain, analytics: the accounts are in your name and handed over to you. You stay with us by choice, never because the door is shut.

priceMethod.title: How the price is set
priceMethod.text: There is no honest single rate for a custom application: the price depends on what there is to build. What we commit to is the method: the price is settled during scoping, announced before development starts, and does not move afterwards.
points: The scope is frozen during scoping: the price matches that scope, in writing.
No billing by time spent, so no overrun discovered along the way.
An idea that comes up mid-project is quoted separately: you decide whether to take it or keep it for later, and the initial price does not change.
priceMethod.note: For a first product, the MVP in 30 days offer applies the same method, with a fixed price and a launch date both known from the start.

design.text: The design starts from your business, not from a template. Mockups and user flows are drawn in-house, with you.

build.text: Developed with modern web technologies, like this site. No plugin assembly: code we know line by line.

maintain.text: After launch, the foundations keep being cared for. You stay by choice, never out of necessity.
